assumptions: Rank0 rank_action timestamps are local inclusive wall spans; verify span includes both-host pipeline + rank1 ACK.
Width-(k+1) verify cost = measured width2 verify + (k-1)*dw; dw_full = measured width2 verify - native width1 step (linear extrapolation), dw_half = optimistic.
Each extra chained draft costs the measured draft+snapshot span (upper bound; snapshot is per round, so this overcharges slightly).

Acceptance of draft i = alpha*r^(i-1); r=1 is i.i.d. geometric. Depth>=2 MTP acceptance is UNMEASURED: Qwen3.x ships one MTP layer; chaining it on its own hidden output is expected to lose acceptance (r<1) but the size is unknown.
Catch-up of j accepted drafts into the head KV is one batched head call costing the measured depth-1 advance span; commit cost is the measured prefix-1 commit.
